page.overview:
Who is Avitla?

Avitla was a Human female member of the Jedi Order who undertook her Jedi Trials as a Padawan on the planet Tython during the Cold War. Around 3643 BBY, she accompanied fellow Padawans Mennaus and Jerridan to the Tythonian Gnarls to seek knowledge of the Jedi Code, but they were interrupted by native Flesh Raiders.

The trio fought and killed one Flesh Raider, although Jerridan was badly wounded. Although Avitla wished to keep fighting till the group's trial was finished, another Padawan arrived and told them to return to safety, giving them a signal beacon to summon a speeder.

Avitla was a Force-sensitive Human who served in the Jedi Order as part of the Galactic Republic during its Cold War against the Sith Empire. Avitla was training as a Padawan on Tython, the homeworld of the Jedi. As part of her Jedi Trials, she accompanied fellow Padawans Mennaus and Jerridan into the Tythonian Gnarls region to seek knowledge of the Jedi Code.

The trio's trials were interrupted when they were attacked by Tython's native Flesh Raiders. Having not received combat training, the three Padawans fought a lone Flesh Raider near the Tythos River Delta and killed them, although Jerridan was badly injured during the battle. While Mennaus tended to Jerridan's injury, Avitla suggested they keep fighting until their trials were complete. Mennaus disgreed, but confirmed that he could help Jerridan along if Avitla was determined to keep going.
